title: Toddler in Romper Standing on Lawn, 1950s Deckled Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a young toddler standing on an open grassy lawn or hillside on a bright day. The child sports a mid-century bowl haircut with straight bangs, wearing a light short-sleeved top, a gathered romper or sunsuit, white socks, and soft baby shoes. Characteristic of the post-WWII baby boom era, this candid family snapshot features white scalloped deckle edges typical of late 1940s to 1950s amateur photo finishing.
